brief.role: Software Engineer (New Grad) — k0rdent AI Platform
brief.location: Remote (must be authorized to work in the United States)
key_requirements: Bachelor's degree in CS/Software Engineering or equivalent demonstrated ability
Solid CS fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking, HTTP/databases
Proficiency in at least one systems/backend language (Go, Java, C++, Rust, C#, Python) with ability to ramp up in Go quickly
Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modeling
Evidence of self-driven building (internships, personal projects, OSS contributions, hackathons)
Authorization to work in the United States required
brief.company_summary: Mirantis is a Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company (founded 1999, HQ Campbell, CA) that provides cloud-native and AI infrastructure orchestration software, including its k0rdent AI platform, serving 1,500+ enterprise customers across 90 countries. In 2026 Mirantis was acquired by IREN (NASDAQ: IREN), a bare-metal GPU/AI cloud provider, in a ~$625M all-stock deal to combine Mirantis's software/orchestration expertise with IREN's GPU infrastructure at scale.
culture_signals: Emphasizes mentorship for new grads — code reviewed by senior engineers across US, Europe, and India
Encourages learning-by-doing: 'we do not expect you to arrive knowing our stack'
Values self-driven builders, curiosity, and rigorous code review/feedback culture
Long open-source heritage (OpenStack, Kubernetes, k0s, k0rdent) suggests engineering-driven, community-oriented culture
Recently recognized as a Leader/Challenger in industry analyst reports (Forrester, Gartner, Omdia) — signals technical credibility
Company is mid-acquisition/integration (by IREN) — culture and priorities may be in flux during transition
talking_points: Highlight any personal/open-source projects involving Go, distributed systems, or Kubernetes — the role explicitly wants a project you can walk through in depth
Emphasize CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, concurrency, networking) since the role is fundamentals-heavy for a new grad
Show curiosity about AI infrastructure / GPU orchestration and mention interest in k0rdent, Kubernetes-native platforms, or CNCF ecosystem
Demonstrate a 'figure it out' mindset — mention examples of debugging unfamiliar systems or reading source code independently
Reference Mirantis's recent momentum (IREN acquisition, k0rdent CNCF conformance, Gartner/Forrester recognition) to show you've researched the company's current AI infrastructure pivot
red_flags: RemoteOK listing implies 'Probably worldwide' remote, but actual job req explicitly requires US work authorization — location mismatch/ambiguity
Company recently acquired by IREN (2026) — potential for organizational restructuring, role changes, or culture shifts during integration
New-grad-level compensation/scope not disclosed (RemoteOK hides salary behind premium paywall)

Experience with monday.com and HRIS platforms such as Rippling
Tech-savvy and comfortable using AI tools for documentation/process efficiency

brief.company_summary: The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a boutique/full-service U.S. immigration law firm founded in 2012, with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, plus international operations across Asia, Africa, and Latin America. The firm handles employment-based, family-based, and investment immigration cases and was named a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree.

Positive: Recognized by JPMorgan Chase as a 'Community Icon' for immigrant community support
Positive: Job listing mentions structured onboarding, Pacific Time-aligned flexible hours, birthday recognitions, team appreciation

Negative: At least one Yelp review raises serious complaints about document handling quality, though this is a single/anecdotal review

Emphasize U.S.-based HR operations experience (onboarding, compliance, employee lifecycle) to meet the 2-year minimum requirement

brief.company_summary: Copenhagen Optimization is a Denmark-based SaaS company founded in 2014 that provides 'Better Airport,' a cloud-based platform helping airport operators optimize check-in, baggage, security, stand & gate, and immigration operations. It serves 40+ airports globally (including Heathrow, JFK, Dallas Fort Worth, Sydney, and Brisbane) and in January 2025 sold a majority stake to French investment firm InfraVia Capital Partners to accelerate growth.
